name: Northbeam
description: Northbeam lets agents read attributed revenue, spend, and return on ad spend across marketing channels and campaigns. Each user signs in to their own Northbeam account through the browser.

prompts.text: What was ROAS by channel over the last 30 days?
Which Meta campaigns drove the most attributed revenue last week?
Compare spend and revenue this month with last month.

apps.name: Northbeam
apps.description: Attribution and channel performance reporting, over Northbeam's MCP server with browser sign-in.
